c.v: These registers are responsible for the configuration/control/status of the global features of OTG_FS (i.e., features which are common to both Host and Device modes).
These features include OTG control (HNP, SRP, and A/B-device detection), USB configuration (selecting Host or Device mode and PHY selection), and system-level interrupts.
Software can access these registers whilst in Host or Device modes.
These registers are responsible for the configuration/control/status when operating in Host mode, thus should only be accessed when operating in Host mode.
Each channel will have its own set of registers within the Host mode CSRs.
These registers are responsible for the configuration/control/status when operating in Device mode, thus should only be accessed when operating in Device mode.
Each Endpoint will have its own set of registers within the Device mode CSRs.
A single register used to control power-down and gate various clocks.
